title: Library vs Framework: The Real Difference Every Developer Should Know
description: Understanding the difference between a library and a framework is crucial for developers. This guide breaks it down with beginner-friendly explanations, real-world analogies, and practical React and Next.js examples.

image.pageAlt: Side-by-side flowchart of library vs framework control flow: your project calls a library like React, so you decide structure, flow and logic; a framework like Next.js calls your project's code and defines structure, routing and rules.

authorBio: Full-stack developer working with React, Next.js, Flask and Node.js. I write about the decisions behind the code, not just the syntax.
